description: Polish the three external planner/calendar components used in OverviewTab: ProductivityScore.tsx, GoalSetting.tsx, and Heatmap.tsx. Removes ALL-CAPS treatment from section headings, reduces card border weight to hairlineWidth, and adds missing lineHeight values. All three files are independent of each other and of index.tsx changes (FEAT-004).
steps: 1. Ensure branch 'feat/dashboard-ui-refinement' is checked out: git -C /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner checkout feat/dashboard-ui-refinement
2. Read the FULL file src/components/planner/ProductivityScore.tsx before making any changes.
3. In ProductivityScore.tsx makeStyles function, change the 'card' style: borderWidth from 1 to StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. Ensure StyleSheet is imported from 'react-native' (it already is).

4. In ProductivityScore.tsx makeStyles function, change the 'headerText' style: remove textTransform: 'uppercase', remove letterSpacing: 0.8, change fontSize from 12 to 13, add lineHeight: 20. Keep fontWeight: '600' as-is.
5. Read the FULL file src/components/planner/GoalSetting.tsx before making any changes.
6. In GoalSetting.tsx makeStyles function, change the 'card' style: borderWidth from 1 to StyleSheet.hairlineWidth.
7. In GoalSetting.tsx makeStyles function, change the 'addFormCard' style: borderWidth from 1 to StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. The backgroundColor: 'transparent' stays unchanged.

8. In GoalSetting.tsx makeStyles function, change the 'sectionTitle' style: remove textTransform: 'uppercase', remove letterSpacing: 0.8, change fontSize from 12 to 13, add lineHeight: 20. Keep fontWeight: '600' as-is.
9. Read the FULL file src/components/calendar/Heatmap.tsx before making any changes.

10. In Heatmap.tsx, change the module-level 'styles' object (at the bottom of the file): (a) card.borderWidth: change from 1 to StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. (b) title style: change fontWeight from '700' to '600', remove letterSpacing: 0.6, add lineHeight: 16. Keep fontSize: 11 (it fits the tight desktop header row). Ensure StyleSheet is imported from 'react-native'.

11. In Heatmap.tsx, change the 'makeMobileStyles' factory function: in the 'title' style, change fontSize from 11 to 13, change fontWeight from '700' to '600', remove letterSpacing: 0.6, add lineHeight: 20.
12. In Heatmap.tsx MobileMonthHeatmap component JSX: change the ACTIVITY text string from 'ACTIVITY' to 'Activity' (single occurrence in the sectionHeader View).

13. In Heatmap.tsx main Heatmap component JSX (desktop path): change both occurrences of 'ACTIVITY (LAST 12 MONTHS)' to 'Activity (last 12 months)'. One occurrence is in the regular desktop view, one is in the empty-state (!hasData && isWide) return.
14. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' from /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. Fix any TypeScript errors before proceeding.
15. Run 'npx vitest --run' from /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. All 18 tests must pass.
16. Stage only the three changed files: git add src/components/planner/ProductivityScore.tsx src/components/planner/GoalSetting.tsx src/components/calendar/Heatmap.tsx
17. Commit: git commit -m 'refactor(dashboard): sentence-case headings and hairline borders in ProductivityScore, GoalSetting, Heatmap'. Record the commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: ProductivityScore headerText has no textTransform:'uppercase' and no letterSpacing property
ProductivityScore headerText fontSize is 13 with lineHeight: 20
GoalSetting sectionTitle has no textTransform:'uppercase' and no letterSpacing property
GoalSetting sectionTitle fontSize is 13 with lineHeight: 20
Heatmap styles.title has fontWeight '600', no letterSpacing, lineHeight: 16
Heatmap makeMobileStyles title has fontSize 13, fontWeight '600', no letterSpacing, lineHeight: 20
Heatmap desktop renders 'Activity (last 12 months)' (not 'ACTIVITY (LAST 12 MONTHS)') in both regular and empty-state paths
npx tsc --noEmit exits with zero errors
